title: crataegus sieboldii
intro: Crataegus sieboldii, commonly known as Siebold's hawthorn, is a species of hawthorn tree that is native to East Asia. It is a deciduous tree that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of C. sieboldii include acting as a cardio-tonic, vasodilator, and antioxidant, which help to protect against cardiovascular disease and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of C. sieboldii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
